{{Short description|Best selling fiction authors to date in any language}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=May 2020}}
This is a '''list of best-selling fiction authors''' to date, in any language. While finding precise sales numbers for any given author is nearly impossible, the list is based on approximate numbers provided or repeated by reliable sources. Numbers given are estimated copies sold of all fiction books written or co-written by an author. To keep the list manageable, only authors with estimated sales of at least 100 million are included. Authors of comic books are not included unless they have been published in book format (for example, [[Franco-Belgian comics#Formats|comic albums]], [[manga]] [[tankōbon]] volumes, [[Trade paperback (comics)|trade paperbacks]], or [[graphic novel]]s).

Some authors, including [[Jane Austen]], [[Miguel de Cervantes]], [[Alexandre Dumas]], [[Charles Dickens]], [[Arthur Conan Doyle]], [[Victor Hugo]], [[Jules Verne]], [[Ernest Hemingway]], [[Jack Higgins]], [[Isaac Asimov]] and [[Leon Uris]] have not been included in the table because no exact figures could be found, although it is possible that they too have more than 100 million copies of their work in print.
